result.rationale: The diff shows `rss.items.each` with no per-item error handling in poll_feed (`content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and `TopicEmbed.import` can raise on a bad item), and the job declares `sidekiq_options retry: false`. Since a raise mid-loop aborts the remaining iterations and the job is never retried, a persistently bad feed item would block all subsequent items on every hourly run — a real robustness/data-loss defect introduced by this new code, verifiable from the diff.
